blessing.horseshoe-iron.name: Horseshoe iron

bloodline-node.light-keepers.name: Light-Keepers

build.blood-desc: A shadow is walled into the foundation. Its owner dies within forty days. It cannot be undone.
build.labour-hint: Assign villagers to Construction to raise the work under way. Unfinished work is done by the year's end.
building.chapel.level-1: Services and night vigils; holy water.
building.chapel.level-2: A crypt altar for offerings; more oil stored.
building.chapel.level-3: A relic shrine; Sanity recovers faster at dawn.
building.chapel.name: Chapel
building.herbalists-hut.level-2: Drying racks: remedies no longer spoil.
building.herbalists-hut.name: Herbalist's hut
building.inn.desc: A roof for travellers, and their news.
building.inn.level-2: Music and drink: fear spreads slower.
building.inn.level-3: A yearly fair; newcomers of every trade.
building.inn.name: Inn
building.school.desc: Letters for the children of Mrak.
building.school.level-1: Lore and Investigation training; more journal pages.
building.school.level-2: Villagers learn skills; the Confessor tree opens.
building.school.level-3: A chitalishte: reading rooms and evenings of songs.
building.school.name: School
building.watchtower.desc: Early warning and a fire against the dark.
building.watchtower.level-1: Early warning; the night watch defends better.
building.watchtower.level-2: A signal fire: a safe zone around the tower.
building.watchtower.level-3: A bell of its own; strong defence.
building.watchtower.name: Watchtower
building.workshop.desc: A forge and a bench: tools, iron and silver.
building.workshop.level-2: Iron and silver working; consecrated oil.
building.workshop.level-3: Heirloom repair. A shadow was walled into the foundation.
building.workshop.name: Workshop
cabinet-set.dowry-of-the-drowned.desc: A bride’s mirror and a samodiva’s pendant, side by side. Two promises nobody kept; together they are quiet.
cabinet-set.dowry-of-the-drowned.name: Dowry of the Drowned
cabinet-set.price-of-mrak.desc: The coin that paid and the doll that took. Under one glass, the debt forgets your name a little.
cabinet-set.price-of-mrak.name: The Price of Mrak
calling.priests-acolyte.ability.desc: Once per night, a prayer restores 15 Sanity and turns a bad omen neutral.
calling.priests-acolyte.ability.name: Kyrie
calling.priests-acolyte.desc: You served at the altar before you could read. The village expects you to stand between them and the dark with a censer and a cross.
calling.priests-acolyte.name: Priest's Acolyte
calling.znaharka.ability.desc: Pour molten lead into water over a frightened villager: learn what they fear, and whether something unnatural is involved.
calling.znaharka.ability.name: Lead pouring
calling.znaharka.desc: The village calls for you when the priest has given up. You know which herb is picked at dawn and which word is whispered three times.
calling.znaharka.name: Znaharka
caption.paths-shift: Branches creak; the paths have moved
character.boon: (blessing ready: +1 Fate on your next check today)
character.notice.0: Nothing in the dark seems to know your name.
character.notice.1: Now and then you feel watched.
character.notice.2: Something follows your thoughts when you study the old books.
character.notice.3: The dark knows your face. It looks for you at night.
character.notice.4: You are seen. In dreams, something waits at the foot of your bed.

character.ready: Ready to grow — raise the cap
character.sin-hint: while your faith holds, it stays quiet.
character.sin-rules: your corruption is greater than your faith: it may speak for you, and forbids some kindnesses.
character.skills-hint: Skills grow by use, up to their cap. Revelation raises the cap.
character.title: The guardian
character.virtue-hint: acting by it strengthens your faith and steadies your hand the next time it matters.

chronicle.none: This chronicle has no long-term goals.
chronicle.ready: The story is told, but the valley goes on. Choose how dark the years ahead will be.

clue.g-ballad.desc: The old song: a builder walls his young wife's shadow into the bridge so it will stand; she dies within forty days, unless the thread is burned.
clue.g-ballad.name: The ballad of the walled-in bride
clue.g-dance-ring.desc: A ring of trampled frost at the forest edge, as if someone danced there barefoot.
clue.g-dance-ring.name: A ring in the frost
clue.g-fresh-mortar.desc: One stone in the new weir is set in mortar still soft. A red fibre sticks out of the joint.
clue.g-fresh-mortar.name: Fresh mortar in the weir
clue.g-measured.desc: Radka saw a man kneel behind Mara at dusk by the mill path, drawing a red thread along the ground. She thought it a game.
clue.g-measured.name: A thread at dusk
clue.g-mill-debt.desc: Dimo says the miller owes him the price of the new weir. If it falls again, Krastyo loses the mill.
clue.g-mill-debt.name: The mill must stand
clue.g-neda-alibi.desc: Velika swears Baba Neda sat at her loom all that evening, teaching her a pattern.
clue.g-neda-alibi.name: Neda sat with Velika
clue.g-neda-threads.desc: Red threads hang on every stake of Baba Neda's garden.
clue.g-neda-threads.name: Red threads in the garden
clue.g-no-shadow.desc: Radka holds the lamp to her daughter. The wall behind Mara stays bare.
clue.g-no-shadow.name: No shadow by the lamp
clue.g-priest-saw.desc: Pop Stoyan says he saw the stranger Todor measuring by the mill path with a cord.
clue.g-priest-saw.name: The priest saw a cord
clue.g-red-sleeve.desc: Velika noticed a red thread caught on the miller's sleeve the day the weir was finished.
clue.g-red-sleeve.name: Red thread on a sleeve
clue.g-todor-cord.desc: Todor's cord is white linen, knotted every fathom. He spent that dusk copying the church register.
clue.g-todor-cord.name: A linen cord
clue.g-wheel-voice.desc: Krastyo mutters that the wheel speaks at night now, in a girl's voice.
clue.g-wheel-voice.name: A voice in the wheel
clue.m1-bell.desc: The bell rope is wet and smells of the river.
clue.m1-bell.name: The wet bell rope
clue.m1-carvings.desc: Under the mill floor, old carvings — and Velika's careful copies of them.
clue.m1-carvings.name: Velika's copies of the carvings
clue.m1-charm.desc: The charm in Velika's sleeve is half-burnt from within. It was fighting something.
clue.m1-charm.name: Neda's charm, burnt from inside
clue.m1-crossroads.desc: Petko saw Dimo at the crossroads at midnight on Christmas Eve.
clue.m1-crossroads.name: Midnight at the crossroads
clue.m1-dream.desc: Velika murmurs it in her sleep, again and again.
clue.m1-dream.name: 'The water wants a bride'
clue.m1-flour.name: Flour on the sill
clue.m1-ledger.name: Dimo's ledger
clue.m1-magiya.desc: Hair, grave soil, a rusty nail — and a gold coin of Zlatno.
clue.m1-magiya.name: The bundle under the threshold
clue.m1-name.name: A true name
clue.m1-prints.desc: Wet footprints lead from the threshold — not to it.
clue.m1-prints.name: Footprints from the threshold
clue.m1-quarrel.desc: Radka and Velika's mother quarrelled over a debt last autumn.
clue.m1-quarrel.name: An old quarrel
clue.m1-rope.desc: The tavern rope at the well is knotted left-handed. Velika is left-handed.
clue.m1-rope.name: A left-handed knot
clue.m1-seal.desc: Three rings above a wavy line, drawn with river water and ash.
clue.m1-seal.name: The seal of three rings
collectible.daguerreotype-cemetery.desc: A silvered plate. There are lanterns among the graves that nobody carried.
collectible.daguerreotype-cemetery.name: Daguerreotype: the cemetery
collectible.grimoire-page-mamnik.desc: A water-stained page naming the one who wants a bride.
collectible.grimoire-page-mamnik.name: Grimoire page: the Lurer
collectible.grimoire-page-moon.desc: A torn page in a woman’s hand: how the witches of Thessaly pulled the moon into a copper basin, and what it cost them.
collectible.grimoire-page-moon.name: Grimoire page: drawing down the moon
collectible.relic-koledar-staff.desc: Carved with crosses and suns, carried by the carollers from house to house for a hundred winters.
collectible.relic-koledar-staff.name: Relic: a koledar’s staff
collectible.relic-st-ivan-finger.desc: Wrapped in faded silk in a tin box. The monks of Rila swore it was his; the monks of the ruined monastery swore it was theirs.
collectible.relic-st-ivan-finger.name: Relic: a finger bone of St Ivan
collectible.seal-of-three-rings.desc: Scratched into the monastery wall: three rings above a wavy line.
collectible.seal-of-three-rings.name: The seal of three rings
collectible.song-of-the-haiduti.desc: A haidut song Radka sings only when the aga’s men are gone: forty brave men in the mountain, and one who sold them for a gold coin.
collectible.song-of-the-haiduti.name: Song: “Up in the Balkan”
collectible.song-of-the-mill.desc: Krastyo sings it under his breath when the wheel turns by itself: a miller who ground flour for the dead and was paid in coins that turned to leaves.
collectible.song-of-the-mill.name: Song: “The Mill at Night”
collectible.song-of-the-sleeping-bride.d: A lullaby Velika’s mother sang, and the women of the loom still sing: “Sleep, my girl, the river is not calling, the river only sings.” Velika hums it without knowing.
collectible.tale-of-the-borrowed-name.de: Todor read it in a book from Plovdiv and did not believe it, until he came to Mrak: a demon that cannot be cast out until someone says the name it stole.
collectible.tale-of-the-grave-digger.des: Petko’s tale of a man buried without the rites who came back on the fortieth night, polite and hungry, and sat at his own table.
collectible.tale-of-the-karakondzhul.des: Pop Stoyan tells it to frighten children off the roads on the Unclean Days: a creature that leaps on your back and rides you until the cock crows.
collectible.tale-of-the-water-bride.desc: Grandmothers say the river takes a bride when a debt is owed.
collectible.tale-of-the-water-bride.name: Tale: the water bride
creation.intro: Who takes up the watch over Mrak?
creation.old-save: This chronicle has no guardian yet. Choose who keeps the watch.
creation.soul-hint: Acting by your virtue strengthens your faith. When corruption outweighs faith, your sin starts choosing for you.
creation.title: A new guardian
creation.tree-hint: The other tree of your calling can be learned later for {cost} Revelation.
creature.karakondzhul.desc: A thing of the Unclean Days that leaps on travellers and rides them until they drop.
creature.karakondzhul.name: Karakondzhul
creature.karakondzhul.weakness-cock: The first cock's crow drives it away.
creature.karakondzhul.weakness-salt: A line of salt it will not cross.
creature.karakondzhul.weakness-tar: It will not pass a tar cross on a door.
creature.lesser-bes.desc: A small, quick devil of the swarm. It giggles in the dark and hates holy water.
creature.lesser-bes.name: Lesser bes
creature.returned.desc: A villager buried wrongly, walking back to the house that forgot them. The lantern does not frighten it.
creature.returned.name: The returned
creature.returned.weakness-garlic: Garlic keeps it at the threshold.
creature.returned.weakness-hawthorn: A hawthorn stake lays it to rest.

cursed-object.brides-mirror.desc: A dowry mirror. Carried, it shows you what stands behind you; displayed, it keeps the house watched.
cursed-object.brides-mirror.memory: A girl braids her hair before this mirror on the morning of her wedding. Behind her, in the glass, a second bride is already dressed in white river water.
cursed-object.brides-mirror.memory-echo: The second bride had no reflection of her own. She borrowed the girl’s.
cursed-object.brides-mirror.name: Bride's mirror
cursed-object.rag-doll.desc: Someone made it to take a sickness away. Carried, it takes a little of you instead.
cursed-object.rag-doll.memory: Enyovden, 1779, at the forest edge. The fire has burned down. A woman in a black kerchief — Mara Svetleva — kneels in the ash and lifts out a rag doll with a red belt. It is not even scorched. The baby in her arms stops crying the moment she holds it.
cursed-object.rag-doll.memory-echo: Mara never told Ivan where the doll came from. Kalina slept with it until her wedding.
cursed-object.rag-doll.name: Rag doll
cursed-object.samodiva-pendant.desc: The forest wants it back. Carried, the forest knows where you are.
cursed-object.samodiva-pendant.memory: A summer night in 1779. A barefoot woman walks asleep into the Samodivi Forest. Women in white close their ring around her, and one hangs a pendant on her neck to keep her there till dawn. Far behind them, in the village, a lantern moves inside the byre where no one should be.
cursed-object.samodiva-pendant.memory-ec: They did not keep her for themselves. They kept her away from the byre.
cursed-object.samodiva-pendant.name: Samodiva pendant
cursed-object.zlatno-gold-coin.desc: Found in the bundle under Velika's threshold. It is warm.
cursed-object.zlatno-gold-coin.memory: The crossroads at dusk, summer 1779. Before the herb-woman came up the road: a man in fine boots kneels at the stone and opens his own arm with a knife. A voice from under the stone: ‘A woman of Mrak in every generation. Begin with the herb-woman.’ He scratches a key with three teeth into the first coin.
cursed-object.zlatno-gold-coin.memory-ec: He dropped the coin on purpose. He wanted her to see it.
cursed-object.zlatno-gold-coin.name: Gold coin of Zlatno

darkness-level.darkness-1.name: Darkness 1

darkness-level.darkness-10.name: Darkness 10

darkness-level.darkness-2.name: Darkness 2
darkness-level.darkness-3.desc: Creatures 30% stronger and keener; debt and fear 15% more likely. Legacy x1.3. Rituals roll more Shadow dice.
darkness-level.darkness-3.name: Darkness 3
darkness-level.darkness-4.desc: Creatures 40% stronger and keener; debt and fear 20% more likely. Legacy x1.4.
darkness-level.darkness-4.name: Darkness 4
darkness-level.darkness-5.desc: Creatures 50% stronger and keener; debt and fear 25% more likely. Legacy x1.5.

darkness-level.darkness-6.desc: Creatures 60% stronger and keener; debt and fear 30% more likely. Legacy x1.6. Rituals roll more Shadow dice.
darkness-level.darkness-6.name: Darkness 6

darkness-level.darkness-7.name: Darkness 7

debt-collection.aga-collector.desc: The aga's man comes with a cart and takes what he likes from your store.
debt-collection.aga-shame.desc: The aga has your debt read out in the square. The village pays for your shame.
debt-collection.aga-soldiers.desc: Soldiers come at dusk to collect. They take more than you owed.
debt-collection.bad-dream.desc: You dream of a table laid for two at the crossroads. You wake tired, and the bread has mould.
debt-collection.clause-comes-due.desc: A clause you never read comes due. Something in you is no longer yours.
debt-collection.cold-shoulder.desc: You promised, and you did not come. Doors close as you walk past.
debt-collection.fever-in-a-house.desc: A fever enters the house of someone who trusts you. You know who sent it.
debt-collection.forest-takes-one.desc: Someone went for water and did not come back. The forest has been paid.
debt-collection.knock-at-the-door.desc: Three knocks at midnight. When you open, there is no one — only hoofprints in the frost.
debt-collection.lost-path.desc: The forest takes back its favour: you walk in circles until the cock crows.
debt-collection.samodivi-dance.desc: You hear singing in the meadow. In the morning a girl from the village cannot stop dancing.
debt-collection.sour-milk.desc: Every jug of milk in the village has turned. The women cross themselves and look at your door.
debt-collection.they-stop-asking.desc: Nobody asks you for help any more. They have started to look elsewhere.
debt-collection.whispers-at-the-well.des: At the well they say the guardian keeps no word. Some say worse.
debt-collection.withered-herbs.desc: The herbs in your store have turned black overnight.
debt-remedy.blood-offering.desc: A cut palm, three drops on the stone. Sanity −15, Corruption +3.
debt-remedy.blood-offering.name: Blood at the crossroads
debt-remedy.honey-and-milk.desc: Bread and wax left for the forest. It remembers kindness — a little.
debt-remedy.honey-and-milk.name: Gifts under the old oak
debt-remedy.keep-your-word.desc: A long day of work for those you failed. Sanity −5, Faith +2.
debt-remedy.keep-your-word.name: Make amends
debt-remedy.repay-the-aga.desc: Five silver coins, counted twice by his man.
debt-remedy.repay-the-aga.name: Repay the aga
debt-source.aga-loan.name: The aga's loan
debt-source.borrowed-strength.name: Borrowed strength
debt-source.bound-demon.name: A bound demon
debt-source.broken-promise.name: A broken promise
debt-source.dark-talent.name: A gift of the Horned One
debt-source.devils-luck.name: Devil's luck
debt-source.forest-favour.name: A favour of the forest
debt-source.horned-crown.name: The horned crown
debt-source.inherited-pact.name: A forebear's pact
debt-source.pact-minor.name: A small pact
debt.chance: Each dusk there is a {value}% chance that someone comes to collect.
debt.hint: Debt is paid in what you love. The more you owe, the sooner and the worse.
debt.history-empty: Nothing has been collected — so far.
demon.lesser-bes.fragment.confession: "It laughed and said -chko," the boy admits.
demon.lesser-bes.fragment.grimoire: "The little ones answer to Bes-", the page says.
demon.lesser-bes.lore: Nameless unclean ones. They knock, spill, snuff candles — and slip into the terrified.
demon.lesser-bes.name: Lesser bes
demon.lesser-bes.phrase-2: This body is warm. Why would I leave?
demon.lesser-bes.symptom-2: They hear knocking no one else hears.
demon.lesser-bes.symptom-3: They will not cross the church threshold.
demon.lesser-bes.taunt.death: {name} died while you watched. Did you pray, or did you count?
demon.lesser-bes.taunt.debt: You still owe for {debt}. Everyone in the dark knows it.
demon.lesser-bes.taunt.lynching: They hanged {name}. You let them. We ate well that night.
demon.lesser-bes.taunt.pact: You signed {pact}. I can smell the ink on you.
demon.lesser-bes.taunt.sacrifice: You bled something for us once. We remember the taste.
demon.mamnik.fragment.confession: "It told me its end: -osh," she whispers.
demon.mamnik.fragment.grave: On the old cross, under moss: "-ni-".
demon.mamnik.fragment.grimoire: The page names it "Mam-", and the ink runs.
demon.mamnik.fragment.photograph: The plate shows letters in the veil: "-kar".
demon.mamnik.lore: It feeds the Lake of the Drowned. Zlatno's tithe is often paid to it.
demon.mamnik.name: Mamnik
demon.mamnik.phrase-2: This body is warm. Why would I leave?
demon.mamnik.seal.form: Three linked rings above a wavy line
demon.mamnik.symptom-2: Thirst; wet footprints in a dry room.
demon.mamnik.symptom-3: Sleepwalking toward wells and the lake.
demon.mamnik.taunt.death: {name} died while you watched. Did you pray, or did you count?
demon.mamnik.taunt.debt: You still owe for {debt}. Everyone in the dark knows it.
demon.mamnik.taunt.lynching: They hanged {name}. You let them. We ate well that night.
demon.mamnik.taunt.pact: You signed {pact}. I can smell the ink on you.
demon.mamnik.taunt.sacrifice: You bled something for us once. We remember the taste.
demon.mamnik.weakness-3: The host's name sung by their family.
demon.uroka.desire-1: That nobody may have more than another.
demon.uroka.fragment.grimoire: A margin note: "the eye is called Ur-".
demon.uroka.fragment.photograph: In the plate, the glance spells "-ana".
demon.uroka.lore: Built on the old fear of the evil eye: praise that sickens, looks that sour milk.
demon.uroka.name: Uroka
demon.uroka.phrase-2: This body is warm. Why would I leave?
demon.uroka.symptom-3: Neighbours fall ill after their praise.
demon.uroka.taunt.death: {name} died while you watched. Did you pray, or did you count?
demon.uroka.taunt.debt: You still owe for {debt}. Everyone in the dark knows it.
demon.uroka.taunt.lynching: They hanged {name}. You let them. We ate well that night.
demon.uroka.taunt.pact: You signed {pact}. I can smell the ink on you.
demon.uroka.taunt.sacrifice: You bled something for us once. We remember the taste.
demon.uroka.weakness-2: Being charmed off by a znaharka.
dialogue.requires.flag: Needs something you have not learned yet
dialogue.sin-spoke: Your {sin} spoke before you could think.
endless.clue.a-convenient-story.desc: Someone is sure it was another. Too sure.
endless.clue.a-convenient-story.name: A convenient story
endless.clue.alibi.desc: They were at the vigil all night; others swear to it.
endless.clue.alibi.name: An alibi
endless.clue.at-the-tavern.desc: They were drinking until the cocks crowed.
endless.clue.at-the-tavern.name: At the tavern
endless.clue.drag-marks.desc: A man's weight, not a spirit's, moved the stone.
endless.clue.drag-marks.name: Drag marks
endless.clue.false-word.desc: A neighbour names someone else, too quickly.
endless.clue.false-word.name: A false word
endless.clue.hawthorn-splinters.desc: Splinters of a stake in their sleeve.
endless.clue.hawthorn-splinters.name: Hawthorn splinters
endless.clue.kept-the-wake.desc: They sat with the widow all that night.
endless.clue.kept-the-wake.name: Kept the wake
endless.clue.lead-shapes.desc: The poured lead shows an eye.
endless.clue.lead-shapes.name: Shapes in the lead
endless.clue.mud-on-boots.desc: Field mud, on the morning the stone moved.
endless.clue.mud-on-boots.name: Mud on their boots
endless.clue.new-furrow.desc: The furrow runs where the stone used to be.
endless.clue.new-furrow.name: A new furrow
endless.clue.pointed-finger.desc: A villager accuses another and will not meet your eyes.
endless.clue.pointed-finger.name: A pointed finger
endless.clue.praise-without-spit.desc: They praised the calf and never spat after it.
endless.clue.praise-without-spit.name: Praise without a spit
endless.clue.seen-at-the-byre.desc: Someone saw them stroke the cow before dawn.
endless.clue.seen-at-the-byre.name: Seen at the byre
endless.clue.spade-marks.desc: The cut of their spade, in the grave earth.
endless.clue.spade-marks.name: Spade marks
endless.clue.stake-in-the-coffin.desc: Someone was afraid the dead would walk.
endless.clue.stake-in-the-coffin.name: A stake in the coffin
endless.moved-boundary-stones.guilty: Their land grew by a furrow.
endless.moved-boundary-stones.name: Moved boundary stones
endless.moved-boundary-stones.question: Who moves the boundary stones at night?
endless.outcome.right: The village breathes again. It was who you said.
endless.outcome.unsolved: The year turned and nobody answered. The village remembers.
endless.outcome.wrong: The wrong door was knocked on. The evil goes on, and someone innocent pays.
endless.remedy.exhume: Exhume and lay it to rest
endless.remedy.lead-pouring: Pour lead to break the eye
endless.soured-milk.guilty: They have looked too long at other people's cows.
endless.soured-milk.name: Soured milk
endless.soured-milk.question: Whose evil eye sours the milk?
endless.whispering-grave.guilty: They feared the dead more than the living.
endless.whispering-grave.innocent: They loved the one buried there.
endless.whispering-grave.name: The whispering grave
endless.whispering-grave.question: Who opened the old grave?

error.content.title: The chronicle is damaged
error.crash.body: The game stopped unexpectedly. Reloading usually helps.
error.crash.title: Something went wrong
error.load.body: Part of the game could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
error.load.title: Something did not arrive

event.aga-loan.name: The aga's loan
event.aga-loan.text: The aga's man counts eight coins into your hand and writes your name in his book.
event.bell-at-333.name: The bell at 3:33
event.bell-at-333.text: The church bell rings three times. The tower is locked. Petko is asleep in his chair, the key on his belt.
event.black-hen-at-crossroads.name: A black hen
event.black-hen-at-crossroads.text: A black hen, tied by one leg, stands at the crossroads. Someone left it there on purpose.
event.calf-with-human-eyes.name: The calf
event.calf-with-human-eyes.text: A calf was born in the night. It looks at you with a man's eyes, and it blinks like one.
event.candle-gutters.name: A candle gutters
event.candle-gutters.text: The candle flame bends low and flattens, though the air in the room is still.
event.chains-on-the-road.name: Chains on the road
event.chains-on-the-road.text: Something drags a chain along the frozen road. The karakondzhuli walk in the Unclean Days, the old men say.
event.children-singing.name: Children singing
event.children-singing.text: Children are singing a koleda you have never heard, in the dark, in the empty schoolroom.
event.cradle-rocks-empty.name: The empty cradle
event.cradle-rocks-empty.text: Somewhere a cradle is rocking. There has been no child in that house since the fever.
event.dog-howls.name: A dog howls
event.dog-howls.text: Every dog in the lane howls at once, at nothing, and stops at once.
event.door-left-open.name: Your door
event.door-left-open.text: Your door is open. You closed it. The snow on the threshold has no footprints.
event.empty-mask.name: The empty mask
event.empty-mask.text: Twelve dancers left the square. Thirteen masks came back. The last one turns to you; there are no eyes behind it.
event.footsteps-on-roof.name: Steps on the roof
event.footsteps-on-roof.text: Slow footsteps cross the roof above you, from the chimney to the eaves.
event.girl-without-a-shadow.name: The girl without a shadow
event.girl-without-a-shadow.text: Radka runs to you with a lamp in her hand. "Look at the wall," she says. "Look behind my Mara."
event.grave-disturbed.name: Disturbed earth
event.grave-disturbed.text: The earth of a fresh grave has been turned, from the inside or the outside, no one can say.
event.icon-weeps.name: The weeping icon
event.icon-weeps.text: The icon of the Virgin by the church door is wet with dark tears.
event.knocking.name: Knocking
event.knocking.text: Three knocks at a door down the lane. Then nothing.
event.koledari-procession.name: The koledari
event.koledari-procession.text: Young men with staffs and bread rings go singing from house to house. Where they sing, the dark draws back.
event.milk-turns-to-blood.name: Milk and blood
event.milk-turns-to-blood.text: A cow gives milk red as blood. The neighbours speak of witches who steal milk by the moon.
event.mother-at-the-window.name: At the window
event.mother-at-the-window.text: A woman stands at your window in a burial scarf. She has your mother's face.
event.owl-on-chimney.name: An owl on the chimney
event.owl-on-chimney.text: An owl settles on a neighbour's chimney and calls. The old women say it is counting the house.
event.peddler-at-the-gate.name: A peddler at the gate
event.peddler-at-the-gate.text: Word has spread that Mrak is doing well. A peddler from Plovdiv leaves oil and salt at the gate.
event.reflection-lags.name: The reflection
event.reflection-lags.text: In the water of the basin your reflection turns its head a moment after you do.
event.second-bell.name: The bell again
event.second-bell.text: The church bell tolls once more. In the morning, no one in Mrak will say they heard it.
event.shared-dream.name: The same dream
event.shared-dream.text: At the well, three women say they dreamed of the river last night. The same river. The same voice.
event.shutters-bang.name: Shutters
event.shutters-bang.text: A shutter bangs open in the wind. You latched it at dusk. You are sure you did.
event.sleepwalkers-to-lake.name: Toward the water
event.sleepwalkers-to-lake.text: Barefoot shapes walk in a line toward the mill pond, eyes open, saying nothing.
event.stranger-knows-your-name.name: A stranger at the fence
event.stranger-knows-your-name.text: A man in good boots stands at the fence and says your name, softly, as if remembering it.
event.velika-sleepwalks.name: Footsteps toward the well
event.velika-sleepwalks.text: A woman in a wet shift walks barefoot toward the forest, her eyes open.
event.villagers-staring.name: In the doorways
event.villagers-staring.text: Your neighbours stand in their doorways in the dark, all of them, watching you pass.
event.well-bucket-rattles.name: The well bucket
event.well-bucket-rattles.text: The bucket chain of the well rattles, as if someone below were climbing it.
event.whispers-from-hearth.name: The hearth
event.whispers-from-hearth.text: Under the crackle of the fire, something is whispering in the old language.
exorcism.name: Speak the name: {name}
exorcism.no-name: You do not know any true name yet.
exorcism.title: Exorcism

festival.enyovden.desc: Midsummer: herbs picked before sunrise have the most power.
festival.enyovden.name: Enyovden
festival.enyovden.threat: Witches and samodivi gather herbs the same night; the Pact is renewed at the crossroads.
festival.kukeri.desc: Masked men in sheepskins and great bells dance through the village to drive the evil out.
festival.kukeri.name: Kukeri
festival.kukeri.threat: Lesser besove hide in the houses; the bells drive them out. One mask in the procession is empty.
festival.nestinari.desc: Fire-dancing on embers with the icons, a Strandzha rite Zlata brought to Mrak and keeps in secret.
festival.nestinari.name: Nestinari
festival.nestinari.threat: Ognitsa, the Ember, wakes in the embers of the dance.
festival.rusalia-week.desc: The week after Pentecost, when the samodivi roam and nobody works, swims or sleeps outside.
festival.rusalia-week.name: Rusalia Week
festival.rusalia-week.threat: The samodivi roam the fields and waters; the forest takes whoever sleeps outside.
festival.unclean-days.desc: Twelve nights between Christmas and Theophany, when the waters are unbaptized and the unclean ones walk.
festival.unclean-days.name: The Unclean Days
festival.unclean-days.threat: Karakondzhuli roam the unbaptized nights; the waters are unclean.
festival.zadushnitsa.desc: All Souls: wine on the graves, candles and kolivo for the dead.
festival.zadushnitsa.name: Zadushnitsa
festival.zadushnitsa.threat: All the badly buried return at once.

game.title: MRAK
gather.boost.enyovden: Enyovden: every herb is twice as strong today.
gear.bless-failed: The blessing did not take. The materials are spent.
gear.blue-bead.desc: A blue glass eye on a string, against the evil eye.
gear.blue-bead.name: Blue bead
gear.cassock.desc: Black wool, frayed at the hem. People lower their voices when they see it.
gear.cassock.name: Cassock
gear.censer.desc: Swung on a chain; its smoke is a prayer.
gear.censer.name: Censer
gear.hint: Prepare for what you will face: each piece has blessing slots. Blessings need materials and a check.
gear.knife.name: Knife
gear.knife.upgrade.whetted: Whetted and balanced (+1 blessing slot, +1 Fate on Combat)
gear.lantern.desc: Light is life — and your only weapon.
gear.lantern.name: Lantern
gear.sheepskin-coat.desc: A kozhuh with the wool inside. It has slept on frozen ground and woken.
gear.sheepskin-coat.name: Sheepskin coat
gear.wooden-cross.name: Wooden cross
glossary.aga.desc: Ottoman local notable/landholder with administrative power; here the district's tax authority.
glossary.badnik.desc: The Christmas Eve log, kept burning through the night.
glossary.baene.desc: Charming: whispered healing incantation by a znaharka.
glossary.bedel-i-askeri.desc: Military-exemption tax paid by non-Muslims after 1856.
glossary.budni-vecher.desc: Christmas Eve; meatless supper with an odd number of dishes.
glossary.chorbadzhiya.desc: Christian village notable, often tax intermediary and lender.
glossary.cizye.desc: Poll tax on non-Muslim subjects, until 1856.
glossary.corruption.desc: How far the Horned One has reached into you. It never fades on its own.
glossary.darkness-level.desc: Difficulty tier in the Endless Chronicle.
glossary.debt.desc: Accumulated dark obligation from pacts and favours.
glossary.faith.desc: Trust in God and the saints; spent on prayers and rites.
glossary.fate.desc: Dice of a check: Fate dice help, Shadow dice hinder.
glossary.gaida.desc: Bagpipe / the large low-pitched Rhodope bagpipe.
glossary.generation.desc: Each guardian is one generation of the bloodline; the next inherits the scars.
glossary.grosh.desc: Silver piastre, the main coin; 40 para = 1 grosh.
glossary.guardian.desc: The player character; a Svetlev on watch.
glossary.haidut.desc: Armed outlaws/rebels of the mountains; folk heroes and feared.
glossary.hysteria.desc: The fear of the whole village. High hysteria leads to accusations and worse.
glossary.kadi.desc: Ottoman judge; the only lawful authority for capital cases.
glossary.karakondzhul.desc: Demon of the Unclean Days that rides people.
glossary.kiliyno-uchilishte.desc: Cell school in a church or monastery annex.
glossary.koledari.desc: Young men singing carols house to house on Christmas Eve night.
glossary.kolivo.desc: Boiled wheat with sugar/nuts, offered for the dead.
glossary.kuker.desc: Masked, belled dancers who drive away evil.
glossary.kurban.desc: Sacrificial communal feast (shared practice among Christians and Muslims in the Balkans).
glossary.leene-na-kurshum.desc: Pouring molten lead into water to diagnose and cure fright.
glossary.light.desc: Lamp oil and candles. Without light the night belongs to them.
glossary.magiya.desc: Sorcery; also a hidden bundle used to curse.
glossary.martenitsa.desc: Red-and-white thread worn from 1 March for health.
glossary.mora.desc: Nightmare spirit that sits on sleepers.
glossary.navi.desc: Souls of unbaptized infants, appearing as birds.
glossary.nechistiya.desc: "The unclean one" — euphemism for the devil.
glossary.notice.desc: How much the demons "see" the guardian (forbidden knowledge).
glossary.omen.desc: Good/bad sign attached to a check result.
glossary.open-hint: Folklore, history and game terms. Shortcut: F2.
glossary.pomaks.desc: Bulgarian-speaking Muslims, many living in the Rhodopes.
glossary.revelation.desc: Experience earned from milestones; spent on talents, attributes, skill caps.
glossary.rogatiya.desc: "The horned one" — euphemism for the devil; MRAK's Horned One.
glossary.sancak.desc: Ottoman province subdivision (Mrak lies in the sancak of Filibe/Plovdiv).
glossary.sanity.desc: Your hold on what is real. It is never shown as a number; when it breaks, the world stops telling the truth.
glossary.stopan.desc: House guardian spirit, often a snake.
glossary.survachka.desc: Decorated cornel branch used for New Year blessings.
glossary.talasam.desc: Spirit guarding a building, created by an immured shadow.
glossary.the-thracian-horseman.desc: The ancient power under the mine (from the historic Thracian Horseman cult).
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.vgradena-senka.desc: "Immured shadow": a person's shadow measured and built into a foundation.
glossary.yatak.desc: A haidut's hidden supporter who gives shelter and food.
glossary.yordanovden.desc: Theophany (6 January), blessing of the waters.
goal.century: A century of the Endless Chronicle
heir.inherits: The heir inherits the pacts and their debt, curses, family belongings and the journal pages marked for them. Not the talents, skills or Revelation.
heir.line-ended: Nobody is left to take the lantern. The line of guardians ends here.
heir.title: The burden passes
heir.too-young: The only heir is still a child. The village keeps watch until they come of age.
hint.first-dawn.text: You lived through the night. By day, tend to the village: hysteria grows if people are afraid and alone.
hint.first-dawn.title: Dawn
hint.first-decision.text: What you just chose is written in the chronicle. Some choices can never be taken back; the game asks before those.
hint.first-decision.title: Decisions leave scars
hint.first-night-light.text: Night has fallen. Your light (top left) burns down; when it runs out, the dark gets closer. Carry oil.
hint.first-night-light.title: Keep a light burning
hint.first-night-sanity.text: The bar under your resources is your sanity. It has no numbers: trust what it says, not what you see.
hint.first-night-sanity.title: Mind your sanity
hint.first-night-save.text: At night only autosaves are made. Survive until dawn to save by hand again.
hint.first-night-save.title: No saving by hand at night
hint.label: Hint
hint.low-sanity.text: You may see and hear things that are not there. Rest, pray or drink calming tea to steady yourself.
hint.low-sanity.title: Your mind is slipping
hint.prologue-glossary.text: Unfamiliar words are folklore of the Rhodopes. Press F2 or the ? button any time to open the glossary.
hint.prologue-glossary.title: Strange words
hint.prologue-hud.text: The screen clears itself when nothing happens. Press Tab to show everything again.
hint.prologue-hud.title: A quiet screen
hint.prologue-interact.text: When a prompt appears at the bottom of the screen, press the key it shows. Right-click (or long-press) for every action at once.
hint.prologue-interact.title: Talk and look closer
hint.prologue-inventory.text: Press I to open your belongings. Drag items to move them; right-click one to use it.
hint.prologue-inventory.title: What you carry
hint.prologue-journal.text: Press J for the journal: what Stana must do today is written there. Places to go are marked on the map.
hint.prologue-journal.title: Your tasks
hint.prologue-lamp.text: It is getting dark. Press L to light your lamp; it burns oil. Hold Shift to run home.
hint.prologue-lamp.title: The lamp
hint.prologue-map.text: Press M for the map. It fills in as you walk; task places are marked.
hint.prologue-map.title: The map
hint.prologue-move.text: Walk with WASD or the arrow keys (left stick on a gamepad). Everything you can use glows faintly.
hint.prologue-move.title: Find your way
hint.prologue-save.text: The game saves by itself. By day you can also press F5 to save, and Esc pauses and opens the menu.
hint.prologue-save.title: Saving
hint.prologue-sleep.text: Go home and use your house to sleep until morning.
hint.prologue-sleep.title: Sleep
hint.prologue-talk.text: In a conversation, pick an answer with the mouse or the number keys. Some answers change how people see you.
hint.prologue-talk.title: Choices
hud.controls: WASD or arrows: walk · Shift: run · L: lantern · M: map · Esc: pause
hud.label: Time and place
hud.lantern.desc: Burns one measure of oil every quarter hour. Without light, darkness wears at your mind.
hud.phase-desc: Time of day. Night begins at dusk and ends at cock crow.
item.basil.desc: Bosilek. The priest dips a sprig of it to sprinkle holy water.
item.basil.name: Basil
item.beeswax.name: Beeswax
item.bread.desc: A round loaf. Eating by the road steadies the nerves a little.
item.bread.name: Bread
item.brides-mirror.desc: A dowry mirror in a painted frame. When you look away, it does not.
item.brides-mirror.name: Bride's mirror
item.calming-tea.desc: Restores Sanity, or calms a frightened villager.
item.calming-tea.name: Calming tea
item.consecrated-oil.desc: Oil blessed at the chapel; its light burns demons.
item.consecrated-oil.name: Consecrated oil
item.daguerreotype-camera.desc: A walnut box with a brass lens. It takes minutes to make one picture, and the picture keeps what the eye refused.
item.daguerreotype-camera.name: Daguerreotype camera
item.elder-syrup.desc: Sweet and cool. Breaks a fever and the mood that comes with it.
item.elder-syrup.name: Elderflower syrup
item.elder.desc: Bez. Its flowers sweat out a fever; its wood is never burned indoors.
item.elder.name: Elderflower
item.fern-blossom.desc: The fern flowers one night a year, on the eve of Enyovden, and whoever picks it sees hidden things.
item.fern-blossom.name: Fern blossom
item.fever-brew.name: Fever brew
item.firewood.name: Firewood
item.garlic-braid.desc: Hung at the door or worn: vampires and besove keep away.
item.garlic-braid.name: Garlic braid
item.garlic.name: Garlic
item.grave-moss.desc: It grows only on the north side of old crosses, and only shows itself at night.
item.grave-moss.name: Grave moss
item.grave-salve.desc: Moss and salt pounded together. Rubbed on the eyelids, the dark seems thinner, and something looks back.
item.grave-salve.name: Grave salve
item.hawthorn-stake.desc: The only wood a vampire fears.
item.hawthorn-stake.name: Hawthorn stake
item.holy-water.name: Holy water
item.incense.name: Incense
item.iron.name: Iron
item.juniper.desc: Smreka. Burned on the hearth on the Unclean Days so the dead keep their distance.
item.juniper.name: Juniper berries
item.lamp-oil.desc: One measure of oil — a quarter of an hour of light.
item.lamp-oil.name: Lamp oil
item.lead.desc: A lump of lead for pouring.
item.lead.name: Lead
item.mistletoe-charm.desc: A sprig bound with red thread. Worn against the evil eye.
item.mistletoe-charm.name: Mistletoe charm
item.mistletoe.desc: Imel, cut from the old oak in the cold months. Hung over doors against the evil eye.
item.mistletoe.name: Mistletoe
item.photographic-plate.desc: A copper plate silvered and fumed with iodine. One plate, one picture.
item.photographic-plate.name: Silvered plate
item.rag-doll.desc: Stuffed with straw and a lock of hair. Someone sewed its eyes shut.
item.rag-doll.name: Rag doll
item.red-thread-amulet.desc: A knotted charm against the evil eye.
item.red-thread-amulet.name: Red-thread amulet
item.red-thread.desc: Wool dyed red, against the evil eye.
item.red-thread.name: Red thread
item.salt.name: Salt
item.samodiva-pendant.desc: A coin of no kingdom on a thread of hair. Found where the grass grows in a ring.
item.samodiva-pendant.name: Samodiva pendant
item.seeing-tincture.desc: Fern blossom steeped in Theophany water. For a while nothing can hide its face.

mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.cause.demo: A demon lives in her and casts no shadow
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.cause.immu: Her shadow was measured and built into a wall (vgradena senka)
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.cause.samo: The samodivi danced away her shadow
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.krastyo.gu: The miller rebuilt the weir this autumn. Old builders say a wall stands only if a shadow is built into it.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.krastyo.in: Krastyo carried Mara across the ford when she was small. He weeps when he hears of her.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.name: The Girl Without a Shadow
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.neda.guilt: Red threads hang in the herb-woman's garden, and thread is how a shadow is measured.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.neda.innoc: Neda ties red thread against the evil eye, as every grandmother in the Rhodopes does.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.outcome.kr: The weir is broken open; the thread burns blue at the crossroads. Mara's shadow returns at noon. Krastyo leaves Mrak before the snow.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.outcome.ne: The village burns Neda's charms and spits at her door. Mara fades within the forty days.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.outcome.to: Todor is driven out on the Zlatno road. Mara fades within the forty days.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.partial: Krastyo confesses — but the thread stays in the wall, and Mara fades within the forty days.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.question: Who took Mara's shadow, how, and how can it be given back?
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.remedy.con: Confront the miller before the village
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.remedy.dri: Drive the stranger out of Mrak
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.remedy.exh: Break open the weir, take out the thread, burn it at the crossroads
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.todor.guil: The stranger from Bucharest walks the village with a measuring cord.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.todor.inno: Todor measures fields for the tax register, not people.
mystery.girl-without-a-shadow.unsolved: No one breaks the weir. On the fortieth day Mara does not wake.
mystery.wasting-bride.cause.magiya-and-m: A curse-bundle opened a door for the Lurer
mystery.wasting-bride.dimo.guilty: Respected, pious, helpful in the search. Nothing points at him — at first.
mystery.wasting-bride.krastyo.guilty: Seen near Velika's house at night; flour on her windowsill; the mill is an unclean place.
mystery.wasting-bride.krastyo.innocent: He was teaching her to read the carvings under the mill.
mystery.wasting-bride.name: The Wasting Bride
mystery.wasting-bride.neda.guilty: Her charm was found sewn into Velika's sleeve. 'The old witch', people whisper.
mystery.wasting-bride.neda.innocent: The charm is protective. It is what has kept Velika alive.
mystery.wasting-bride.outcome.dimo: Dimo confesses and flees to Zlatno. The coin in the bundle is the first proof of what Zlatno is.
mystery.wasting-bride.outcome.krastyo: Krastyo is handed to the aga's men for sorcery and debts. The mill stops.
mystery.wasting-bride.outcome.neda: They take Baba Neda to the forest edge, as they took Stana.
mystery.wasting-bride.outcome.radka: Radka shutters the tavern. The mountain men stop coming.
mystery.wasting-bride.question: Who brought the evil on Velika, and how is it cast out?
mystery.wasting-bride.radka.guilty: She quarrelled with Velika's mother, and her rope was found at the well.
mystery.wasting-bride.radka.innocent: Velika took the rope herself, sleepwalking.
mystery.wasting-bride.remedy.burn-magiya: Burn the bundle and cast out the demon by its true name and seal
mystery.wasting-bride.remedy.punish-the-: Punish the one who cursed her
mystery.wasting-bride.unsolved: At Theophany dawn, Velika walks into the water.

site.home.story: It is the winter of 1834. By day you are the guardian of Mrak: you mend roofs, ration lamp oil, settle quarrels and listen to what the old women will not say aloud. By night the same village belongs to something else, and your lantern is both your life and your only weapon. Mrak withers while neighbouring Zlatno prospers. Finding out why — and what you are willing to do about it — will take generations.

village.title: The village
villager.baba-neda.bio: She delivered half the village. Some of them now call her a witch behind her back.
villager.baba-neda.name: Baba Neda
villager.baba-neda.secret.stanas-ashes: She knows where Stana's ashes were buried; her grandmother was there in 1779.
villager.chorbadzhi-dimo.bio: He collects the taxes for the aga and owns the best fields. He sleeps with a lamp lit.
villager.chorbadzhi-dimo.name: Chorbadzhi Dimo
villager.chorbadzhi-dimo.secret.the-magi: On Zlatno's orders he buried the bundle under Velika's threshold.
villager.krastyo.bio: He runs the watermill below the forest. Mills are unclean places, people say.
villager.krastyo.name: Krastyo
villager.krastyo.secret.voice-in-the-whe: He has heard a voice in the wheel; it told him where old carvings lie.
villager.petko.bio: He rings the bell and digs the graves. He is afraid he rang the bell in his sleep.
villager.petko.name: Petko
villager.petko.secret.empty-graves: In 1829 he reburied three 'plague dead' from Zlatno at night. The graves were empty.
villager.pop-stoyan.bio: He believes, mostly. He fears more that God has turned away from Mrak.
villager.pop-stoyan.name: Pop Stoyan
villager.pop-stoyan.secret.zlatno-silver: He takes Zlatno's silver 'for the church roof' and does not record certain burials.
villager.radka.bio: A widow who keeps the mehana and its one room. She hears everything.
villager.radka.name: Radka
villager.radka.secret.yatak: She shelters haiduti in her loft.
villager.todor.bio: He teaches letters in the church annex and dreams of a real school.
villager.todor.name: Todor
villager.todor.secret.bucharest-letter: He keeps an unanswered letter from a revolutionary committee in Bucharest.
villager.velika.bio: She weaves cherga rugs and will marry Todor at Theophany. Her brother drowned when she was small.
villager.velika.name: Velika
villager.velika.secret.reading-lessons: At night she has been learning to read the carvings under the mill.
virtue.compassion.desc: Acting with compassion strengthens your faith.
virtue.compassion.name: Compassion
virtue.courage.desc: Acting with courage strengthens your faith.
virtue.courage.name: Courage
virtue.humility.desc: Acting with humility strengthens your faith.
virtue.humility.name: Humility
virtue.loyalty.desc: Acting with loyalty strengthens your faith.
virtue.loyalty.name: Loyalty
virtue.mercy.desc: Acting with mercy strengthens your faith.
virtue.mercy.name: Mercy
virtue.patience.desc: Acting with patience strengthens your faith.
virtue.patience.name: Patience
virtue.truthfulness.desc: Acting with truthfulness strengthens your faith.
virtue.truthfulness.name: Truthfulness
whisper.name: …your name, again and again…
zone.monastery.desc: A ruin above the village, empty since its last monk left.
zone.monastery.name: Monastery of St. Elijah
zone.monastery.poi.altar.desc: Bare stone. The last monk took the cloth with him.
zone.monastery.poi.altar.name: The altar
zone.monastery.poi.altar.narration: You kneel. For once, the silence is only silence.
zone.monastery.poi.bell.desc: Cracked, lying where it fell from the tower.
zone.monastery.poi.bell.name: The fallen bell
zone.monastery.poi.bell.narration: You touch the rim. It hums, long after it should have stopped.
zone.monastery.poi.crypt.desc: Stairs into the dark under the nave.
zone.monastery.poi.crypt.name: The crypt
zone.monastery.poi.crypt.narration: Your light reaches the bottom step and stops, as if the dark were a wall.
zone.monastery.poi.monks-graves.desc: Wooden crosses, all leaning the same way.
zone.monastery.poi.monks-graves.name: Monks' graves
zone.monastery.poi.monks-graves.narratio: Every cross leans towards the crypt.
zone.monastery.poi.oil-cellar.desc: The monks' store of lamp oil. One barrel is still sealed.
zone.monastery.poi.oil-cellar.name: Oil cellar
zone.monastery.poi.well.desc: Covered with a millstone, but not all the way.
zone.monastery.poi.well.name: Cloister well
zone.monastery.poi.well.narration: Something below breathes when you breathe.
zone.monastery.poi.zdravets.desc: Wild geranium growing between the fallen stones of the cloister.
zone.monastery.poi.zdravets.name: Zdravets among the stones
zone.samodivi-forest.desc: Beech and fog. The paths do not stay where you left them. The crossroads lies at its edge.
zone.samodivi-forest.name: Samodivi Forest
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.bone-cairn.desc: Stones piled over something small. Too many stones.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.bone-cairn.name: Bone cairn
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.bone-cairn.narr: Between the stones: a child's shoe, very old, and perfectly dry.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.crossroads.desc: Where the forest roads meet. Bargains are struck here, they say.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.crossroads.name: The crossroads
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.crossroads.narr: Three roads, though you only walked one of them in.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.elder-bush.desc: An old elder by the water, heavy with cream-white flowers in early summer.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.elder-bush.name: Elder bush
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.fern-hollow.des: A damp hollow full of ferns. On one night of the year, people say, one of them flowers.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.herbs.desc: St John's wort and yarrow, if you know where to look.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.herbs.name: Herb patch
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.hunters-cache.d: A barrel hidden under branches. Someone meant to come back for it.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.juniper.desc: Low, prickly bushes with blue-black berries, green the whole year.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.juniper.name: Juniper bushes
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.mistletoe-oak.d: Green balls of mistletoe high in the bare oak, cut only when the moon grows.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.old-oak.desc: A landmark that never moves. Ribbons and coins are tied to its bark.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.old-oak.name: The old oak
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.old-oak.narrati: You tie a thread to the bark. The tree feels like the only steady thing tonight.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.samodiva-circle: A ring of mushrooms where the grass never grows. Do not step inside at night.
The ring is warm underfoot. Somewhere, very close, a woman laughs.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.spring.desc: Clear water from under the rock. Cold enough to clear the head.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.spring.name: The spring
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.wormwood.desc: Silver-grey wormwood on the dry slope. The air smells bitter.
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.wormwood.name: Wormwood slope
zone.samodivi-forest.poi.yarrow-meadow.d: Flat white umbels of yarrow along the path.
zone.village.desc: The village: church, tavern, mill, cemetery and the houses between.
zone.village.name: Mrak
zone.village.poi.basil-pots.desc: Clay pots of bosilek on Baba Neda’s windowsill and beds.
zone.village.poi.basil-pots.name: Basil pots
zone.village.poi.bonfire.desc: The fire the watch keeps burning through the Unclean Days.
zone.village.poi.bonfire.name: Plaza fire
zone.village.poi.byre.desc: Where the village keeps its cattle in the heat.
zone.village.poi.byre.name: The byre
zone.village.poi.cemetery.desc: Crosses of oak and a few stones. Petko keeps it — mostly.
zone.village.poi.cemetery.name: Cemetery
zone.village.poi.cemetery.narration: The earth on two graves is darker than the rest, as if turned last week.
zone.village.poi.chapel-oil.desc: The parish's allocation of lamp oil, kept by the side door.
zone.village.poi.chapel-oil.name: Chapel oil store
zone.village.poi.church-porch.desc: Where the village gathers after the liturgy.
zone.village.poi.church-porch.name: The church porch
zone.village.poi.church.desc: Whitewashed walls, a slate roof and a bell that sometimes rings on its own.
zone.village.poi.church.name: Church of St. Nicholas
zone.village.poi.crossroads-stone.desc: Three roads, and a stone nobody remembers putting there.
zone.village.poi.crossroads-stone.name: The crossroads stone
zone.village.poi.elders-oak.desc: The old men of Mrak have settled quarrels under it for longer than anyone remembers.
zone.village.poi.elders-oak.name: The elders' oak
zone.village.poi.forest-edge.desc: Where the fields stop and the Samodivi Forest begins.
zone.village.poi.forest-edge.name: The forest edge
zone.village.poi.garden.desc: Baba Neda's beds of garlic and herbs.
zone.village.poi.garden.name: Garlic garden
zone.village.poi.grave-moss.desc: Pale moss on the north side of the oldest crosses.
zone.village.poi.grave-moss.name: Moss on the old crosses
zone.village.poi.guardian-house.desc: Your father’s house: the store room, the mortar by the hearth and, in the cellar, the cabinet.
zone.village.poi.guardian-house.name: Your house
zone.village.poi.house-dimo.desc: The headman's house: the only slate roof besides the church.
zone.village.poi.house-dimo.name: Chorbadzhi Dimo
zone.village.poi.house-krastyo.desc: The miller's house across the river.
zone.village.poi.house-krastyo.name: Krastyo
zone.village.poi.house-neda.desc: The midwife's house, nearest the forest. Herbs hang from the eaves.
zone.village.poi.house-neda.name: Baba Neda
zone.village.poi.house-petko.desc: The sexton's house, by the cemetery gate.
zone.village.poi.house-petko.name: Petko
zone.village.poi.house-radka.name: Radka
zone.village.poi.house-stoyan.desc: The parish house, beside the church.
zone.village.poi.house-stoyan.name: Pop Stoyan
zone.village.poi.house-todor.desc: The teacher's house, its window full of books.
zone.village.poi.house-todor.name: Todor
zone.village.poi.house-velika.desc: The weaver's house. Her loom clacks late into the night.
zone.village.poi.house-velika.name: Velika
zone.village.poi.marija-gate.desc: A gate with a horseshoe nailed above it, points up.
zone.village.poi.marija-gate.name: Marija's gate
zone.village.poi.mill.desc: Krastyo's water mill. People say the wheel speaks at night.
zone.village.poi.mill.name: The mill
zone.village.poi.mill.narration: The wheel creaks round. For a moment it sounds like a name.
zone.village.poi.old-grave.desc: A stone with the name chiselled off.
zone.village.poi.old-grave.name: The nameless grave
zone.village.poi.old-grave.narration: Someone scraped the name away with care. Fresh flowers lie at its foot, and half-buried among them, a rag doll with a red belt.
zone.village.poi.stana-house.desc: A low house of black stone at the edge of the gardens.
zone.village.poi.stana-house.name: Stana's house
zone.village.poi.tavern.desc: Rakia, gossip and the warmest hearth in Mrak.
zone.village.poi.tavern.name: Radka's tavern
zone.village.poi.tavern.narration: Inside, the talk stops when you open the door — then starts again, lower.
zone.village.poi.well.desc: Deep, cold, and the centre of every rumour.
zone.village.poi.well.name: Village well
zone.village.poi.well.narration: Far below, the water ripples, though nothing fell in.
zone.village.poi.woodpile.desc: Where the village splits its firewood, at the edge of the forest.
zone.village.poi.woodpile.name: Woodpile
zone.village.poi.woodpile.narration: Fresh chips in the snow. Someone has been working here since dawn.
